pairsRight: There are many organizations who offers different levels of enterprise software capabilities as cloud services or “as a Service” offerings.

Another cloud offering which is getting popular these days is "IDaaS" which is "Identity as a Service" which provides various Identity and Access Management capabilities as a cloud offering.
